provenance.encodes: The Indigo Book, R12.4.2 (Slip opinions), for a United States Supreme Court slip opinion
provenance.how_to_verify: Open the Indigo Book, R12.4.2 (Slip opinions), and compare the form with this pattern; open the Supreme Court docket page the template builds for a docket number.

positive.text: Moore v. Harper, No. 21-1271, slip op. at 5 (U.S. June 27, 2023).
See 303 Creative LLC v. Elenis, No. 21-476, slip op. at 8-9 (U.S. June 30, 2023).
Compare No. 20-1199, slip op. at 12 (U.S. June 29, 2023) with No. 22A884, slip op. at 1 (U.S. Apr. 21, 2023).

negative: The U.S. slip opinion came out on June 30, 2023.
Docket 21-476 (U.S. June 30, 2023) was argued in December.
The slip op. at the Supreme Court runs 70 pages.

note: A Supreme Court slip opinion: the `(U.S. <date>)` parenthetical names the Court, so the docket number has a home. Priority 62: above us.docket.slip_op (60, the same cite without the court), below us.case.slip_op_online (65, a slip opinion followed by its URL). Slip-opinion PDFs carry a suffix the cite does not give (21-476_c185.pdf), so the template is the docket page, which lists the opinion. url_templates verified by HTTP fetch on 2026-10-23: https://www.supremecourt.gov/docket/docketfiles/html/public/21-476.html answers 200 (also 20-1199 and the application docket 23A12; 99-99999 answers 404).
